summary: Iter 228 — Waiver engine + SetupWizard refactor. All 7 new pytest cases in test_iter228_waiver_engine.py pass (compute_next_run for disabled/days/scheduled modes, next-run endpoint, FAAB highest-bid wins with budget debit + roster update, un-due claims skipped, force=true via route). Frontend Waivers page renders new live data-testid='waivers-next-run' indicator (hardcoded 'Tonight 3:00 AM' is gone; shows 'Waivers disabled' for chriszarek's existing league as expected per the agent_to_agent note). SetupWizard.jsx verified by code inspection — imports DivisionsStep + ScheduleStep from ./wizard/, renders all 6 step IDs (wizard-body-basics/cap/divisions/schedule/trades/generate). Backend scheduler loop runs without errors in supervisor logs. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: SetupWizard.jsx is still 1119 lines after the divisions/schedule extraction — further extraction of basics/cap/trades/generate steps would bring it under the 700-line guideline.
compute_next_run in services/waiver_engine.py treats schedule slot times as UTC; user-facing copy should make the timezone caveat clear (already partially noted in docstring).

waiver_engine.process_pending_claims has no transaction wrapping around the multi-doc updates (winner roster + budget + claim statuses). A mid-run failure could leave partially-applied state; consider a try/rollback or per-claim atomicity guard for production hardening.
test_credentials: Used chriszarek@gmail.com / Chris2026! (commissioner). UI form fill via Playwright did not propagate to React state; bypassed by seeding localStorage from /api/auth/login token — Waivers page then rendered correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter 228 backend pytest (7/7) pass when run from /app/backend (services module needs to be on path). Live UI verification of waivers-next-run testid was successful via localStorage token-seed. SetupWizard wizard-body-* testids verified via code review (lines 676/792/890/893/897/970).
